description: Finish the Doido framework: complete the stubbed macros/crates and ship an end-to-end example app. Definition of done per story: the story's tests pass AND `make verify` exits 0. Backlog seeded from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

userStories.title: Implement the #[mailer] macro expansion
userStories.description: As a Doido user, I want `#[mailer]` to generate mailer plumbing so mailers read like Rails, per docs/08-mailer.md.
acceptanceCriteria: doido-mailer/macros/src/lib.rs generates code (no longer a pass-through) matching the API in docs/08-mailer.md
A new test in doido-mailer/tests exercises a `#[mailer]`-annotated type end to end (compose + TestDeliverer capture)
Test was written first and failed before the implementation (TDD)
make verify passes
userStories.notes: #[mailer] now generates a doido_mailer::Mailer impl with snake_case mailer_name() + template_key() convention; covered by doido-mailer/tests/mailer_macro_test.rs. Trait path is doido_mailer::Mailer (revisit for the doido metacrate re-export path when the example app wires it).

userStories.title: Implement the ActionCable wire protocol frames
userStories.description: As a Doido user, I want cable messages to speak the ActionCable JSON protocol, per docs/12-cable.md.
acceptanceCriteria: doido-cable protocol frames (welcome/ping/subscribe/confirm/message) serialize and deserialize per ActionCable JSON
doido-cable/tests/protocol_test.rs asserts round-trips for each frame type
Tests written first and failing before implementation (TDD)
make verify passes
userStories.notes: Added server->client ActionCable frames: ServerFrame (welcome/ping/confirm_subscription/reject_subscription, type-tagged) + ServerMessage (untyped broadcast). Round-trips in doido-cable/tests/server_frame_test.rs. FOLLOW-UP: client CableFrame still uses `type` tag; real ActionCable uses `command` — migrating breaks protocol_test.rs and cable_test.rs, deferred.
